exemplars.reason: Navy serif headline 'Advancing Academic Rigor & Institutional Excellence' with gold accent rule, gold-bordered Law No. 6 of 2022 callout, and three navy/gold stat cards (02, MSCHE, 100%) on cream form a disciplined, dignified hierarchy, though the mid-section whitespace gap and stat-card top gradient slightly weaken flow.

Navy serif headline with gold eyebrow and rule, numbered standard cards with gold left accents and 'Required Evidence' chips on a cream dotted field form a disciplined, dignified hierarchy, though only Latin typesetting is shown and the logo lockup reads slightly small against the generous top margin.

Serif white headline with gold italic subtitle over Midnight Navy, four evenly spaced glass cards with gold icon tiles and a statutory footer citing Law No. 6 of 2022 deliver a dignified, on-brand institutional roadmap, though the large empty band between header and cards and emoji-style icons slightly weaken polish.

Clean Sorani Kurdish typesetting with a bold navy headline, gold subhead, and an angled midnight-navy banner pairing the AUK crest, though the wide empty gap between the body text and footer line weakens vertical balance.

Clean midnight-navy card with gold Sorani headline, white CHEA/CIQG logo panel and overlapping navy 'CHEA CIQG' tab shows strong hierarchy and brand palette, though the KAAE logo floats loosely top-left and the large empty lower band slightly weakens balance.

Clean Sorani/Latin hierarchy in navy headline with gold subtitle and a navy chevron banner framing the CUE logo on cream grid background, though body text is slightly heavy and lower whitespace feels unbalanced.

exemplars.descriptor: Hero: a real school library classroom with one staff member standing among yellow chairs, literally showing the field visit; it fills the top 55% edge to edge and bleeds off the top, left and right. Second photo: a crowd of pupils with raised hands, blurred and blended upward into the hero at about 45% height, sinking into a navy gradient that becomes solid navy over the bottom 40%; it is texture, not a grid cell. All text sits on the fade, left-aligned at the left margin: a bold uppercase white first line (study name), a bold uppercase gold second line (report type), a light white three-line summary, then a centred 'read the full report at' line above a gold pill holding the URL in navy. A thin gold inset line frames the canvas about 2.5% in from the edge; the logo sits top-left on the bright ceiling. Good because one photo shows the place, the second only adds atmosphere, the fade gives white text strong contrast, and navy, gold and white are the only added colours; the photos keep their natural grade.

exemplars.descriptor: Cover slide of a carousel series. Hero: a symmetrical historic university building under a blue sky, framed by trees, filling the whole canvas inside a thick gold outer frame (about 2.5% of the width); the tower rises into the sky and the top-left sky stays quiet for the logo. A cream card covers the bottom 23% of the canvas, inset from the frame so the photo still shows on three sides of it. A navy wordmark tab (KAAE plus the association's full name) straddles the card's top edge, centred. On the card: a centred gold-brown title question in medium weight, two centred lines of small dark body text listing the accreditation values, and a small navy URL at the bottom. Good because the photo carries the mood, the card gives the text a calm surface, the tab bridges photo and card, and the gold frame marks the series.

exemplars.descriptor: Event invitation with a speaker cut-out on a navy background with a faint lighter grid. The speaker is cut out cleanly (no circle mask) and placed on the left, head to below the waist, bleeding off the left and bottom edges and taking about 45% of the width. The text block sits to her right, left-aligned from about 37% of the width: a bold uppercase gold first line, two large white uppercase lines in regular weight naming the forum, a white body paragraph and the theme line. In the lower right a darker navy quarter-disc with short sunburst rays rises behind her shoulder and holds the date, time and venue in small white type; the logo sits in the bottom-right corner. Good because the person breaks the frame, the rays and disc tie the portrait to the information, and gold is used only for the first line.

exemplars.descriptor: Call for applications on grid paper. The background is a pale warm cream with a fine light grid; a photo of hands reviewing documents with a pen sits in the lower-right 40% and fades softly into the paper along its top and left, with no hard edge. The text is on the paper, left-aligned: a gold uppercase first line on a navy tab that bleeds off the left edge, then a very large bold navy word and a large bold navy uppercase second line; a navy rounded panel bleeding off the left edge holds three short white lines with small icons; two bold navy lines name the network and the levels; a navy pill holds the call to action. A navy band runs along the bottom edge and the logo sits top-right. Good because the photo supports the message without competing with the very large title. Weakness to avoid: the area right of the icon panel is empty.
